query:
SELECT cust_id
            FROM ht_customers
            WHERE cust_active = true
              AND btrim(COALESCE(cust_phone, '')) = btrim($1)
              AND btrim($1) <> ''
              AND lower(btrim(cust_firstname)) = lower(btrim($2))
              AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(cust_lastname, ''))) = lower(btrim(COALESCE($3, '')))
            ORDER BY cust_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
